content: Using NetLogo, I created an agent based model that investigated whether certain team networks are more productive than others. Using R, I analyzed and visualized the results, putting all my findings into a paper I submitted for class.
summary: Analysis and visualization of NetLogo Networks using R
title: Productivity Analysis of NetLogo Networks

content: Interviewed subject matter experts and designed a training based on research based training methodologies. Judged training effectiveness through a pre-test and post-test and presented the findings.

content: I synthesized the findings of 25 published research papers on remote work. The question was to see how it impacts employee attitudes and behaviors differently and how the research has changed over time.
summary: Synthesis of 25 research papers on remote work and its outcomes on employees.
title: Remote Work Outcomes Literature Review

content: As a final assignment, I analyzed and the synthesized the findings of 16 published research papers on positive psychology in the workplace. The paper’s research questions were whether positive psychology is effective and which interventions show the most promising result.
summary: Synthesis of 16 research papers on positive psychology in the workplace.
title: Workplace Positive Psychology Literature Review

content: Based on existing literature and theoretical background, two survey measures were sent out to 524 individuals to determine if there was a correlation between self-esteem and belief in astrology. Using SPSS, I found there was a small, but statistically significant negative correlation, The findings were presented as part of a poster presentation in my course.
summary: Correlation study using measures of self-esteem and astrological beliefs
title: Self-Esteem & Astrological Beliefs
